## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r}
df1 <- read_csv("../data/recist_deseq2_results.csv")
df2 <- read_csv("../data/irAE_deseq2_results.csv")
df3 <- read_csv("../data/irAEsubset_deseq2_results.csv")

```


```{r}
df1_nona <- df1 %>%
  drop_na(padj)


```





## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r volcano plot}


ggplot(dat=df1_nona, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log(padj))) + geom_point()

#class(df1$log2FoldChange)
#class(df1$padj)

```

```{r}

tax_groups <- df1_nona %>%
  mutate(res_non = case_when(log2FoldChange > 0 & padj <= 0.05 ~ "responder",
                               log2FoldChange < 0 & padj <= 0.05 ~ "non responder",
                               TRUE ~ "ns"))  




cols <- c("responder" = "#ffad73", "non responder" = "#26b3ff", "ns" = "grey") 
sizes <- c("responder" = 2, "non responder" = 2, "ns" = 1) 
alphas <- c("responder" = 1, "non responder" = 1, "ns" = 0.5)

tax_groups %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange,
             y = -log(padj),
             fill = res_non,    
             size = res_non,
             alpha = res_non)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21, # Specify shape and colour as fixed local parameters    
             colour = "black") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(log2(0.5), log2(2)),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_size_manual(values = sizes) + # Modify point size
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) + # Modify point transparency
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(seq(-10, 10, 2)),       
                     limits = c(-10, 10))  

```


```{r Responders vs nonresponders}

df1_nona$log2FoldChange[df2$log2FoldChange > 0 & df2$padj <= 0.05]


tax_groups <- df1_nona %>%
  mutate(res_non = case_when(log2FoldChange > 0 & padj <= 0.05 ~ "responder",
                             log2FoldChange < 0 & padj <= 0.05 ~ "non responder",
                             TRUE ~ "ns"),
         Taxonomic_Level = ifelse(padj < 0.05, level, NA))  


#cols <- c("responder" = "#ffad73", "non responder" = "#26b3ff", "ns" = "grey") 

brbgval <- brewer.pal(5, "BrBG")
brbgval[3] <- "#ffad73"


tax_names <- tax_groups %>% mutate(taxnames = ifelse(padj <= 0.05, Taxonomy, NA))

tax_names$taxnames <- gsub("s__|f__|o__|g__|c__", "", tax_names$taxnames)


df1.blautia <-tax_names %>%
  filter(grepl("Blautia", Taxonomy) & threshold == T)

tax_names %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange,
             y = -log(padj))) + 
  geom_point(aes(color= Taxonomic_Level)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(log2(0.5), log2(2)),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  #scale_color_brewer(palette = "BrBG",na.value = "grey50") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = brbgval) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = taxnames),
                   max.overlaps = 5,
                   force = 50,
                   force_pull = 10,
                   min.segment.length = 0.005) +
  geom_label_repel(data = df1.blautia,aes(label = taxnames),
                   max.overlaps = 5,
                   force = 50,
                   force_pull = 10,
                   min.segment.length = 0.005) +
  ggtitle("Responders vs. Non-responders") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

 ggsave("../figures/mitox_volcanoplot_resnon.png",
       height = 7,
       width = 10,
       dpi=400)

 

```

```{r irae drop nas}

df2_nona <- df2 %>%
  drop_na(padj)

```

```{r irae plot}

ggplot(dat=df2_nona, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log(padj))) + geom_point()

df2_nona$log2FoldChange[df2_nona$log2FoldChange > 0 & df2$padj <= 0.05]

 
tax_groups_df2 <- df2_nona %>% mutate(Taxonomic_Level = ifelse(padj < 0.05, level, NA))  

#cols <- c("responder" = "#ffad73", "non responder" = "#26b3ff", "ns" = "grey") 

brbgval <- brewer.pal(5, "BrBG")
brbgval[3] <- "#ffad73"


display.brewer.all()

tax_names_df2 <- tax_groups_df2 %>% mutate(taxnames = ifelse(padj <= 0.05, Taxonomy, NA))

tax_names_df2$taxnames <- gsub("s__|f__|o__|g__|c__", "", tax_names_df2$taxnames)



tax_names_df2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange,
             y = -log(padj))) + 
  geom_point(aes(color= Taxonomic_Level)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(log2(0.5), log2(2)),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  #scale_color_brewer(palette = "BrBG",na.value = "grey50") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = brbgval) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = taxnames),
                  max.overlaps = 10,
                  force = 50,
                  force_pull = 10,
                  min.segment.length = 0.005) +
  ggtitle("irAE and Microbe Abundance") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

 ggsave("../figures/mitox_volcanoplot_irae.png",
       height = 5,
       width = 7,
       dpi=400)

```
